message: The other day, I found myself staring at our smoke alarms, thinking about how long it's been since I really checked them. Instead of the usual techy gadgets, I decided to make fire safety a family affair—so we pulled out some paper and colored pencils and drew our escape plans together. It turned into a fun little art project, and I realized that sometimes the simplest activities can bring everyone together while keeping us safe. Have you had any low-tech fun lately?
